import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3"
API_KEY = "YOUR_TMDB_API_KEY"

search = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/search/movie",
    params={"api_key": API_KEY, "query": "Django Unchained"},
)
search.raise_for_status()
movies = search.json().get("results", [])
django = next(
    (movie for movie in movies if movie.get("title") == "Django Unchained"),
    movies[0] if movies else None,
)

if django:
    credits_response = requests.get(
        f"{BASE_URL}/movie/{django['id']}/credits",
        params={"api_key": API_KEY},
    )
    credits_response.raise_for_status()
    director = next(
        (
            person
            for person in credits_response.json().get("crew", [])
            if person.get("job") == "Director"
        ),
        None,
    )

    if director:
        person_response = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/person/{director['id']}/movie_credits",
            params={"api_key": API_KEY},
        )
        person_response.raise_for_status()
        works = [
            movie
            for movie in person_response.json().get("crew", [])
            if movie.get("job") == "Director"
            and movie.get("id") != django["id"]
        ]
        works.sort(key=lambda movie: movie.get("release_date") or "", reverse=True)
        print(f"Other works directed by {director['name']}:")
        for movie in works[:5]:
            print(f"- {movie.get('title')} ({(movie.get('release_date') or '')[:4]})")
